entries.Serve. A Credituz é um sistema operacion: It works. Credituz is a credit and billing operating system: any business that offers financing or collects recurring payments uses the entire platform. Construction companies screen buyers before financing a down payment; property managers and landlords collect rent automatically via automated billing, payment slips, Pix, and NFe; clinics, schools, and service providers with monthly fees automate collections and reconciliation. The core functions—credit assessment, offering financing, collecting payments, and reconciling accounts—are the same across all of them.
entries.Setup em 5 minutos, interface no padrão: Setup in 5 minutes, an interface based on the WhatsApp/Notion standard (which everyone is already familiar with), and no scheduled training. In addition to the knowledge base and video tutorials, the plan includes live chat support Monday through Friday, from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m., and the ability to open support tickets directly within the platform. The Enterprise plan includes a dedicated customer service representative.
entries.Seu cliente para de dividir orçamento en: Your client no longer has to split their budget between CRM, the WhatsApp call center, the credit simulator, and digital signatures. It’s all in a single system, and the monthly fee goes to you.
entries.Sienge, Kenlo e CV CRM cobram caro por i: Sienge, Kenlo, and CV CRM charge a high price for a 60-day implementation, sell each module separately, and the AI—when it’s included—is just tacked on as an afterthought. Credituz was born as an agency-based platform: a single platform with AI handling everything from credit to collections, up and running in 5 minutes.
